mapper.update: update iip_coupon_record set status = '1', verify_time = sysdate(), verify_merchant_id = #{verifyMerchantId}, verify_by = #{verifyBy}, update_time = sysdate() where record_id = #{recordId} and status = '0'
update iip_coupon_record set status = '2', update_time = sysdate() where record_id = #{recordId} and status = '0'
mapper.select: select coalesce(sum(case when verify_time >= curdate() then 1 else 0 end), 0) as todayCount, coalesce(sum(case when verify_time >= curdate() then points_cost else 0 end), 0) as todayPoints, count(*) as totalCount, coalesce(sum(points_cost), 0) as totalPoints from iip_coupon_record where verify_merchant_id = #{merchantId} and status = '1'
